mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate environment consistently reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 235, it signals elevated inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as bond yields rise and equity valuations contract.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 235.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and a contraction in retail sales (RSAFS) signals a weakening consumer demand, which typically causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 55% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high unemployment (UNRATE > 7.0%), the labor market weakness signals reduced consumer spending power, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings face headwinds.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 7.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market growth, as measured by monthly payroll additions (PAYEMS), consistently indicates robust consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth is above 100k.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 98.0, it indicates a contraction in manufacturing and supply chain activity, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate output and potential recessionary fears.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is below 98.0.

mechanism_narrative: Strong housing starts (HOUST) indicate robust consumer confidence and economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings benefit from a healthy housing market.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST exceeds 850 thousand units.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising inflation (CPIAUCSL > 235) and a stable or rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 0.1) signals an impending monetary tightening cycle, which typically causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to higher discount rates and reduced risk appetite.
failure_condition: The joint signal of CPIAUCSL > 235 and FEDFUNDS > 0.1 fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 55% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.
